odc_type: Incorrect state management in composite object
observation_summary: The JsonParserSequence skips the first token of a concatenated parser when switching to it, resulting in incorrect data retrieval.
reasoning_summary: The JsonParserSequence class is designed to chain multiple JsonParsers. When switching from one parser to the next, the implementation incorrectly calls nextToken() on the new delegate parser immediately. If the new parser is already positioned at a valid token (as is the case when it has been partially consumed or initialized), this extra call causes the sequence to skip the current token, leading to an off-by-one error in the token stream. The failing test confirms this by showing that the sequence returns the value '3' when it should have returned '2'.
